hypotheses.title: Triple Fundamental Style Synergy: Cashflow Efficiency, Earnings Certainty & Analyst Revisions
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms exhibiting simultaneous high cash conversion efficiency per unit of capital, high earnings certainty (low accruals), and rapid sell-side consensus revision momentum possess durable fundamental tailwinds. Operating strictly on derivative ranks with 100% instrument coverage eliminates weight concentration and missing-data decay.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high earnings certainty firms experience sudden accounting restatements.

candidates.rationale: Triple Fundamental Score Synergy with 100% Instrument Coverage

hypotheses.title: Analyst Consensus Earnings Yield & Capital Expenditure Discipline Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the corporate investment anomaly: firms generating strong analyst consensus net income relative to assets while maintaining disciplined capital expenditures generate superior free cash flows. Empire-building firms with bloated capex chronically underperform.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if low-capex firms lose market share to aggressive high-capex competitors.

candidates.rationale: Analyst Consensus Earnings Yield & Capex Discipline

hypotheses.title: Systematic Low-Beta Anomaly & Operational EBITDA Margin Outperformance
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Capital-constrained investors bid up high-beta stocks, creating persistent risk-adjusted outperformance in low-beta equities. Conditioning low-beta selection on wide operational EBITDA margins (fnd2_ebitdm) ensures defensive resilience and fundamental pricing power.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if low-beta stocks are concentrated in structurally declining industries.
